name: Nathaniel (gatekeeper)
title: Levitical temple guard
summary: Nathaniel was one of the Levitical gatekeepers who served at the house of the Lord in David's time, mentioned together with Jathniel and the other guards.

keyEvents.title: Gatekeeper at the temple
keyEvents.description: Nathaniel is listed among the Levitical gatekeepers in the temple service.
